title: Rain on the Clothesline
story: Marta hung the shirts on the balcony line before breakfast. The sky looked clear, so she left the window open and made toast. Soon she heard rain on the glass. She ran outside and pulled the clothes into a basket. Two shirts were already wet. She spread them over chairs in the warm kitchen. Her brother Nico laughed at the dripping sleeves. Marta did not mind. She waited until the rain stopped. Then she carried the dry shirts back outside. The wet ones stayed indoors until evening. She wrote a note that said to look up first. Next time the weather would not surprise her.
